messages:
Marco: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands security segment — can we capture the answers about retention windows, where SOC2/ISO evidence will live, and the KMS BYOK timeline? Need a short summary I can share with a customer.
Priya: Sure. I'll summarize now and link docs. High-level:
- SOC2 evidence: centralized evidence bucket + per-audit exports
- Audit logs: hosted = 365 days, Dedicated = 90 days default (configurable), Private = customer-managed
- KMS/BYOK: beta for Dedicated by end of Q3, Private BYOK already supported for on-prem via HSM

Priya: Quick config snippet for retention (ops will review):
```
audit_logs:
  hosted: 365d
  dedicated: 90d
  private: customer-managed
evidence_bucket: s3://redwood-soc2-evidence
```
Priya: Confluence page: https://confluence.internal.redwood/security/retention-and-evidence
Jules: Legal note — for customer audits we also need signed attestation + chain-of-custody for evidence exports. Tag artifacts with `cust:<customer-id>` and include export manifest.
Cam: Where do we store the manifests? Is that the same bucket or a per-customer path?
Priya: Per-customer path in the evidence bucket, e.g., `s3://redwood-soc2-evidence/<cust-id>/manifests/<timestamp>.json`
Liam: For Dedicated customers, who runs the scheduled exports? Is that on our infra or theirs?
Priya: Exports run from our control plane for Hosted and Dedicated (ops-run), but in Private deployments the export tool is customer-run. Ops owns the export runner for Dedicated.
Liam: Got it. Can we get the export CLI repo and a short runbook? I'll wire up an alert if exports fail.
Priya: Repo + runbook: https://github.com/redwood-infra/audit-exporter and https://confluence.internal.redwood/runbooks/audit-export
Priya: Owners: Ops (Liam) — export runner; Cam — evidence bucket lifecycle & perms; Marco — runbook + external customer summary; Jules — legal attestation template
Marco: Thanks. Two follow-ups from leadership: 1) Sales asked for BYOK timeline for enterprise deals — can we tighten ETA if possible? 2) Need a one-pager we can hand to customers describing what evidence and retention they can expect.
Ava: Leadership priority — BYOK for Dedicated + clear customer-facing docs. Sales is pushing a few RFPs that hinge on this. If we need to reprioritize, tell me what we'd move.
Cam: For S3 lifecycle and encryption, I'll propose lifecycle rules to move logs to Glacier after 90d for hosted; keep primary copies 365d. I'll open a PR with proposed bucket policy.
Priya: One more note: SOC2/ISO audits will expect continuous monitoring evidence. We should start attaching stable IDs to eval data and logs — avoids ad-hoc lookups during audits.
Jules: I'll draft an attestation template and a checklist for artifact packaging. Will post by EOD Tue.
Marco: Action items:
- Marco: produce customer-facing one-pager (due: 2 weeks)
- Cam: PR for lifecycle & bucket policy (due: 1 week)
- Liam/Ops: export runner runbook + alerts (due: 1 week)
- Jules: legal attestation + checklist (due: Tue EOD)
- Priya: update Confluence with retention matrix + owner table (due: 3 business days)
Marco: I'll compile these into a short email to Sales and Customer Success once items land. @Cam @Liam @Jules please confirm owners here.
Cam: Confirmed — I'll own the bucket lifecycle and PR.
Liam: Confirmed — Ops will take export runner and alerting.
Jules: Confirmed — I'll post the template.
calendar-bot: Notes and recording uploaded: https://confluence.internal.redwood/meetings/all-hands/1875309999
Marco: Thanks all. If anyone has customer-specific asks ping me directly and I'll prioritize.
